scope: Independent whole-file mathematical support only; no production/runtime mutation credit or semantic boundary selection.

controls.name: all-nan-payloads-unequal
controls.role: Remove both actual NaN classification guards; identical NaN bits falsely compare equal.

controls.name: opposite-zero-signs-equal
controls.role: Remove the original signed-zero exception; the numeric zero denotations remain equal.

controls.name: original-finite-sign
controls.role: Ignore the original sign during comparison while the numeric denotation retains it.

controls.name: original-finite-fraction
controls.role: Drop original fraction/sign association rather than checking identical values.

controls.name: normal-hidden-leading-bit
controls.before: (HIDDEN as int + frac as int) * pow2((exp - 1) as nat) as int
controls.after: frac as int * pow2((exp - 1) as nat) as int
controls.role: Delete the leading1 of every normal value; numeric bounds and concrete1.0 must refuse.

controls.name: normal-original-numeric-scale
controls.before: (HIDDEN as int + frac as int) * pow2((exp - 1) as nat) as int
controls.after: (HIDDEN as int + frac as int) * pow2(exp) as int
controls.role: Wrong normal binary exponent; equality alone could be invariant, so exact numeric endpoints remain mandatory.

controls.name: nan-is-not-reflexive
controls.role: Give NaNs reflexive denotation equality while retaining original guard/refusal.

controls.name: numeric-comparison-always-refuses
controls.role: Refuse the full comparison operation; nonempty numeric examples and the universal theorem remain unchanged.
